name: inverter
circuit:
CMOS inverter educational level-1 model
Vdd vdd 0 1.8
Vin in 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 100p 100p 4n 8n)
Mp out in vdd vdd PM W=2u L=0.18u
Mn out in 0 0 NM W=1u L=0.18u
Cload out 0 10f
.model NM NMOS (LEVEL=1 VTO=0.45 KP=120u LAMBDA=0.02)
.model PM PMOS (LEVEL=1 VTO=-0.45 KP=60u LAMBDA=0.02)
.control
tran 20p 20n
set wr_singlescale
set wr_vecnames
wrdata inverter.dat v(in) v(out)
quit
.endc
.end
